Production contains 357 obsolete LocalSIM portfolios, 245 stale unfinished LocalSIM orders, old RUNNING/auto-run flags, 59 obsolete unified bindings, 58 obsolete simulation runs, 49 obsolete execution plans, four legacy QMT bindings, 25 unbound pre-refactor MiniQMT SIM runtimes with 29657 events, 768 algo instances and 229 child orders, plus two legacy internal SIM virtual accounts with 82 intents, 81 order-ledger rows, 522 trades, 463 cash-ledger rows, 443 position lots and 198 status events.

description: Implement one governed, digest-pinned transaction that removes obsolete LocalSIM portfolios, unified simulation rows, pre-refactor MiniQMT K2 runtime rows, and legacy internal MiniQMT SIM ledgers while preserving pkg_378eb9c91e104c64935404e257e932ee, pkg_ma_8ec5e389fa2c5e484a1ac7e9, all StrategyPackage definitions, all selection evidence and runtime-release ancestry, and external broker or terminal history.

expected: A dry-run-first and fail-closed maintenance CLI must preserve the two explicitly retained package IDs, all StrategyPackage definitions, all selection evidence and its runtime-release ancestry, and all external broker history; DEV must execute and roll back the DML with exact readback before immutable merged code may apply the digest-pinned production transaction.
